---
id: m90-s02
title: The second of two steps with the same id
kind: concept
minutes: 5
order: 3
exam:
  - cert: none
tags: [broken]
---

<Why>
Two files claim the same step id. Saved progress is keyed by step id, so the second file would silently take over the progress of the first one.
</Why>

<Idea>
Every step id is unique.
</Idea>

<Question id="q-m90-s02" answer="a">
What keys saved progress?

- The step id

  Right.

- The file name

  File names may change.

- The title

  Titles may change.

- The order

  Order may change.
</Question>
